title: Michael W NDE 4864
content: I was ten years old crossing a street heading home for dinner from a friend's house. It was around 6:00 pm Eastern Standard Time on 12/9/1970. A car (Ford LTD) was heading east bound on state route 161 in the north end of Columbus, Ohio. The driver had been drinking alcoholic beverages; my mom said she could smell it on the driver's breath. At the time of the accident I was carrying a wallet so the people that came to help me found my address and was able to find my house a get my parents to the accident site. My NDE experience started the moment the car hit me! As soon as I was hit, I remember going to a dark place, darker than a room without windows and no door or light. The room was darker than I could have ever imagined. Then I remember coming to in the intensive care unit for a moment. The next NDE experience I remember was looking down on my body and seeing several hospital staff personnel rushing in to work on me. At that point, I remember leaving the building and heading up into the sky. I remember looking back at the hospital. Then I was heading into the light. When I came out of my coma, I remember telling people that the light was as bright as the Sun but it did not harm my eyes. While I was heading in the direction of the light, I was told that it was not my time and I returned to my body. The voice that told me that I had to return to my body I just knew was Jesus Christ. I did not see him I just knew.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A dark place/room: 'darker than a room without windows and no door or light.'

arrival.religious_figure_detail: He did not see Jesus, but 'just knew' the voice was Jesus Christ.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pedestrian struck by a car while crossing the street.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial darkness/void; brief awareness in ICU; then OBE over body; leaving hospital upward into sky; heading toward bright light; told 'not my time' and returned.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Dark void occurred immediately after impact before the hospital OBE; brief ICU awareness occurred between the void and the OBE.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reports a brief moment of coming to in the ICU between the initial darkness and the later out-of-body observation.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “As soon as I was hit, I remember going to a dark place, darker than a room without windows and no door or light.”; “the light was as bright as the Sun but it did not harm my eyes.”; “I was told that it was not my time and I returned to my body.”
